oneOf.title: Text
oneOf.description: Formatted instructions and headings; no answer output.

oneOf.title: Likert scale
oneOf.description: One stable choice key per response. Choice labels are presentation only.

oneOf.title: Single choice
oneOf.description: One stable choice key per response. Choice labels are presentation only.

oneOf.title: Multiple choice
oneOf.description: Unique selected choice keys, with configured cardinality constraints.

oneOf.title: Free text
oneOf.description: Text response; regular expressions use the portable JSON Schema pattern dialect.

oneOf.title: One dimensional scale
oneOf.description: Numeric response with explicit bounds; defaults preserve the existing normalized -1 to 1 range.

oneOf.title: Media stimulus
oneOf.description: Standalone image, audio or video; lifecycle events are distinct from answers.

oneOf.title: Mouse and keyboard monitor
oneOf.description: Mouse coordinates are CSS pixels; keyboard events are emitted only when enabled.

oneOf.title: Face landmark capture
oneOf.description: One landmark row per point, and one blendshape row per category; x/y/z use MediaPipe normalized coordinates.

oneOf.title: Face calibration
oneOf.description: Calibration is an explicit component, replacing special trial-level configuration. Calibration x/y are CSS pixels.

oneOf.title: Completion code
oneOf.description: Runtime-generated code; definition compilation must never generate participant codes.

oneOf.title: End study
oneOf.description: Explicit end marker, outside shuffled assessment trials.

title: Elicit study definition v1
description: Portable authored study. Keys are scoped to their containing object; assets are scoped to the study.
